name: Prince Royal Line welded hydraulic cylinder, 2 1/2 in bore, 1 3/8 in rod
source: Prince Manufacturing product catalog (PrinceCatalog.pdf), The Royal Line 2500 PSI Welded-DA table
remarks: Bore 2 1/2 in, rod 1 3/8 in. Table PSI 2500 (Royal Line 2500 PSI). Models PMC-5408..PMC-5442, strokes 8, 12, 14, 16, 20, 24, 30, 32, 36, 42 in. Weight column unit not labeled (omitted).
